name: Trail Edge Length Parameter (COMPAS CEM)
description: Set the length of a trail edge as an optimization parameter.

inputParameters.name: edge_key
inputParameters.description: The key of a COMPAS CEM trail edge.

inputParameters.name: bound_low
inputParameters.description: The smallest signed length the trail edge may take, negative in compression. The start value must lie between the bounds. Defaults to '-inf'.

inputParameters.name: bound_up
inputParameters.description: The largest signed length the trail edge may take, negative in compression. The start value must lie between the bounds. Defaults to '+inf'.

outputParameters.name: parameter
outputParameters.description: A COMPAS CEM trail edge length parameter.
